summary: Narrow regression on the Operator recovery fix (QC rejection -> rework; blocked readiness -> connect shop). Backend: 6/6 pytest assertions PASS using an in-memory synthetic job fixture plus source-anchor checks on backend/server.py job_action rework branch. Frontend: static source review of frontend/src/App.js actionPanel confirms the three required branches render the correct testids with no artwork-upload fallthrough. No production DB, no auth, no persistent records.
scope: Backend (unit + source anchor) and Frontend (static source review). No HTTP calls, no DB mutations, no Playwright journey required (per request: isolated synthetic fixture only; do not authenticate against production).

verifications.frontend_qc_needs_attention_branch: App.js:313 — current===14 && task.status==='Needs attention' renders <button data-testid="start-rework-button"> calling act('rework'). PASS
verifications.frontend_qc_normal_branch: App.js:314 + QCAction (App.js:355-357) — current===14 (default) renders <button data-testid="record-qc-button">. PASS
verifications.frontend_readiness_blocked_branch: App.js:309 — current===10 renders action-row with <button data-testid="check-readiness-button"> and <button data-testid="connect-shop-button">. PASS
verifications.frontend_no_artwork_upload_on_readiness: artwork-upload-input is only rendered on App.js:303 (current===1 OR current<=6 && status==='Blocked'). Branch is a short-circuit return, so readiness (current===10) cannot fall through to artwork-upload-input. PASS
verifications.backend_rework_lands_task12_reauth: server.py:510-517 rework branch guards on tasks[14].status==='Needs attention', pops authorization, resets tasks[11..15] to Pending, then update_task(job, 11, 'Waiting for approval', 'Re-authorize the verified production PDF.'). Index 11 == task #12 (1-indexed) == human reauthorization. PASS (6/6 pytest assertions incl. source-anchor regex).

critical_code_review_comments: actionPanel ordering in App.js is correct: QC-Needs-attention short-circuit (line 313) precedes the generic QCAction fallback (line 314), so record-qc-button is never shown in a rejection state.
artwork-upload-input is only exposed on current===1 or current<=6 with status==='Blocked'; it cannot leak into readiness (current===10) or QC (current===14) branches due to early returns.
backend rework branch is idempotent-safe: it rejects (AppError) unless tasks[14].status==='Needs attention', guaranteeing it cannot be used as an arbitrary rewind.
seed_data_creation: None. Synthetic job dict exists only in test process memory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Operator recovery UI/API contract is green. If a future change touches server.py rework branch (lines ~510-517) or App.js actionPanel (lines 303-315), rerun /app/backend/tests/test_rework_recovery_regression.py — the source-anchor regex test will flag drift (e.g. accidental update_task(job, 10, ...) or dropping the Needs-attention guard).

Prior recovery bug (QC rejection surfacing artwork upload or readiness branch missing Connect shop) is resolved in the current source: App.js:313 isolates start-rework-button and App.js:309 renders both check-readiness-button and connect-shop-button without the artwork input.
